original_proposal.why: Fathom pitches a single dashboard where 'Sites on a plan share your monthly pageviews' and every plan 'includes at least 50 sites' (usefathom.com, usefathom.com/pricing), and like Plausible it is cookieless with 'No cookie banners required' — Plausible's own docs state 'No cookies, no personal data collection, no consent banners required' (E203). That supports comparing the two on a multi-site, cookieless footing. But Fathom's own pricing page lists the same usage-tiered structure as Plausible's — $15/month up to 100,000 monthly pageviews rising to $470/month at 25,000,000, with a Custom tier above that — just as Plausible's Starter plan is itself priced per pageview tier (E328). Neither company's own pages show a flat fee, so the discovery hypothesis's 'flat-fee' framing for Fathom is not supported by what either site actually publishes.

scope: Read-only replay of captured proposal; no saved profile modified and no new model call.
